500071.name: Branč
500071.note: The live website www.branc.sk has no elections page or archive; its notice board and announcements reach back only sporadically and hold no okrsky document for this vote. The Internet Archive stayed offline (connection refused / 'Temporarily Offline') across repeated retries over about 20 minutes, so archived pages could not be checked. Web search found nothing.

500232.name: Golianovo
500232.note: No document of this vote with the okrsky found on golianovo.sk: the live site keeps only the NR SR 2023 document (súpisné čísla 2–359 / 360–803) among its okrsky documents; the 2026 referendum page has only an 'Oznámenie o čase a mieste konania referenda' without any address split; the notice board lists only 2026 items. The Internet Archive keeps almost nothing of golianovo.sk for 2017–2023 (16 URLs, no elections pages or PDFs).

500372.name: Jelenec
500372.note: The mayor's 'Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností' of 04.03.2024 (on https://www.jelenec.sk/obecny-urad/volby-a-referenda/volby-do-europskeho-parlamentu/) names only the polling room of each of the 2 okrsky, not their territory; the municipality has a single part and no streets, so the okrsky cannot be drawn.

500577.name: Mojmírovce
500577.note: The municipality's current website (new CMS, notice board from 2025) holds only 2026 election documents; the old website (WEBY GROUP CMS) is gone and only partly in the Internet Archive, which has no capture of the notice board or elections page from the weeks before this vote (the European Parliament election 2024), and no okrsky document for it (the 'Voľby a referendá' page captured 2018–2024 lists only old results). Only the 2017 (Voľby 2017 page) and 2026 (referendum) okrsky documents were found.

500941.name: Výčapy-Opatovce
500941.note: The only okrsky document found (Utvorenie volebných okrskov for the referendum of 4 July 2026, 05.05.2026) creates 2 okrsky with both polling rooms in the hall of the Kultúrny dom, Opatovská 204/1, without saying which addresses belong to which okrsok (the voters are split about equally, evidently by voter list); the other votes' pages (live and in the Internet Archive) list no okrsky document. No rules can be written.

501034.name: Bajč
501034.note: The mayor's document for this vote (https://web.archive.org/web/20240530185807/https://www.bajc.sk/e_download.php?file=data/editor/137sk_5.pdf&original=utvorenie%20volebn%C3%BDch%20okrskov.pdf) lists only the 3 okrsky with their polling stations (č. 1 Bajč – Kultúrny dom, č. 2 Chrasť – bývalé pohostinstvo, č. 3 Vlkanovo – Komunitné centrum), no streets or parts; the municipality has 5 parts (Bajč, Chrasť, Kotelnica, Nový Diel, Vlkanovo), so okrsky are fewer than parts and the parts Kotelnica and Nový Diel cannot be assigned from the document; per the rules this is not_found.

501140.name: Hurbanovo
501140.note: The EP 2024 page has only the minutes, e-mail addresses and voter information; no okrsky document. The town's current website has election pages only for EP 2024, referendum 2026 and the 2026 elections; earlier pages (old site hurbanovo.sk/obcan/volby-…) survive only in the Internet Archive, which was unreachable (connection refused / 503). Live site also rate-limited (HTTP 429). Internet Archive (CDX API) refused connections / 503 on retries, so archived pages could not be checked.

501174.name: Iža
501174.note: Iža's okrsky decisions on its notice board (NR SR 2023 of 23.06.2023, president 2024 of 23.01.2024, EP 2024 of 22.02.2024) only create okrsky 1 and 2, both in the Obecný dom (zasadacia miestnosť / galéria), without saying which addresses vote in which; the register has no streets, so no rules can be written. No 2017–2020 okrsky document is on the board. The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout.

501182.name: Kameničná
501182.note: The EP 2024 page lists decision, voter info, delegation, minutes; no okrsky document.

501239.name: Marcelová
501239.note: Found the vote's 'Informácia o vytvorení volebných okrskov a určení volebných miestností' on the website. The document gives each okrsok only its polling station (okrsky 1 and 2 both in the Kultúrny dom, súp. č. 1161; okrsok 3 in the Materská škola, Námestie slobody 1395), with no streets or parts; the municipality has 3 okrsky but only 2 parts (Marcelová, Krátke Kesy), and two stations share one building, so the okrsky cannot be placed from it.

501328.name: Pribeta
501328.note: No usable okrsky document for the EP election of 2024. The mayor's announcement on the news page gives each okrsok only its polling station (okrsok 1: Kultúrny dom, Hlavná ulica 127; okrsok 2: Komunitné centrum, Mládežnícka ulica 1B), no streets; the municipality has one part, so the okrsky cannot be placed from it.

501395.name: Bátorove Kosihy
501395.note: The website keeps only 2026 election files; the only okrsky document found (for the municipal elections of October 2026) names 3 okrsky all in the cultural house no. 1263 with no addresses per okrsok, and the village is a single part with no streets, so no rules can be drawn even from it. The Internet Archive (online) holds no okrsky document of this vote (its 2018-2020 captures of the elections page files are candidate lists and voter information).

501573.name: Gabčíkovo
501573.note: The city's document for this vote ("Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností pre Voľby do Európskeho parlamentu", 23.02.2024) creates okrsky 1-4 but names for each only its polling station, all four in the same building (ZŠ L. Amadého s VJM, Komenského 1081/1, B budova, different classrooms); it lists no streets, house numbers or parts. Gabčíkovo has a single part and k.ú., so the okrsky cannot be placed by part either (prompt: station-only documents are usable only where okrsky equal parts with stations in different parts). No other document of the city (live elections pages 2020-2026, archived Joomla site 2017-2022) lists the okrsky's streets.

501590.name: Horná Potôň
501590.note: EP 2024: only voter information (item 318), e-mail addresses and minutes; no okrsky document. The current site's elections section (live and archived records, categories NR SR 2020, NR SR 2023, referendum 2023, prezident 2024, EP 2024, referendum 2026) holds only voter information, e-mail addresses and minutes for these votes; the only okrsky document is "N-9-volebné okrsky.doc" of 2022 (3 okrsky, places only), which is another vote's.

501603.name: Horný Bar
501603.note: No okrsky determination for the European Parliament election of 8 June 2024 on the obec's website: the notice board archive (all records from 2015) lists no "utvorenie volebných okrskov" for this vote; its 2024 EP notices give only the delegation and voting-card addresses (ids 274, 288). The site search for "okrsk" finds only the 2026 notices. The Internet Archive (CDX API) was unreachable at the time, so archived copies could not be checked.

501662.name: Janíky
501662.note: Okrsky documents on janiky.sk exist only for the National Council election of 2023 (evt_file 3473 + notice 576sk); the sections for this vote (live and archived) hold no okrsky document, and a 2023 document is not valid for this vote.

501719.name: Kútniky
501719.note: The website (a Joomla site listing its notices as PDFs on the home page) never posted an okrsky document except for the 2022 elections (and 2026): the archived home pages of 2021-2026 list for the referendum 2023, NRSR 2023, presidential and EP 2024 and the referendum 2026 only voter information, e-mail notices and commission minutes; the Internet Archive has nothing of 2017-2020 elections and the live site keeps only 2025-2026 notices.

501735.name: Lehnice
501735.note: The municipality (2 okrsky, 5 parts, no streets) publishes no utvorenie volebných okrskov with their territory on its website, live or archived; the EP 2024 page holds only the okrsok zápisnice.

501743.name: Lúč na Ostrove
501743.note: The obec's Voľby page (live, and as the Internet Archive kept it in 2019 and 2022) has a category "Voľby do Európskeho parlamentu v roku 2024" but no decision on the okrsky and polling stations for this vote: only the announcement of the vote, the e-mail address for delegating commission members, the Ministry's information for voters (generic, no okrsky) and, for elections, candidate lists or commission minutes. The live notice board is empty and none of its archived documents (old e_download.php and data/uredni_deska files, file_storage downloads in the CDX) concerns the okrsky. The only okrsky decision the website has is the one for the municipal and regional elections of 24 October 2026 (download.php?file=4486d01c|545), which is not this vote's. The Internet Archive answered. A web search for the okrsky of Lúč na Ostrove found nothing else.

501808.name: Nový Život
501808.note: The website's pages of the votes (news items 'Voľby …', 'Referendum 2026') link no okrsky document of the 2024 EP vote (only results, minutes, voter information); the notice board keeps only current items; the only okrsky document on the site is that of the elections of 24 October 2026. The Internet Archive's web.archive.org refused every connection for over 30 minutes (only the availability API answered), so no archived pages or documents could be read.
tried: https://www.novyzivot.sk/evt_file.php?file=2288 … 2330 (unlinked files of spring 2026, by file name)

501824.name: Okoč
501824.note: The 2024 EP election page has only the information for voters and the delegation e-mail; no okrsky document.
tried: https://www.okoc.sk/e_download.php?file=data/uredni_deska/obsah1_1.pdf … obsah400_1.pdf (every file of the notice board, 244 found, none on okrsky)

501859.name: Orechová Potôň
501859.note: No okrsky document found for this vote. The current website (since about 2024) has no elections page; its notice board (all 10 pages) lists for elections only the 2026 municipal/regional notices (candidates, commission, obvody). The Internet Archive's CDX of orechovapoton.sk (2016–2026) lists the old site's election pages (information for voters, e-mail addresses, the 2018 page stating 'Počet okrskov: 2') and result records, but no 'utvorenie volebných okrskov' or list of streets per okrsok. The Internet Archive was offline at times but answered after retries.

501921.name: Topoľníky
501921.note: No okrsky document of this vote found. The current website (topolniky.sk, new CMS) shows on its notice board only the okrsky of the elections of 24 October 2026; the old WordPress site's pages for this vote, as far as the Internet Archive kept them (2019-2020 NRSR voter information, the 2023 referendum page, 2022 candidate lists), carry no okrsky notice; the only okrsky announcement found is that of the National Council election of 2023.

502006.name: Vrakúň
502006.note: The live site keeps only the October 2026 okrsky notice (okrsok 1 časť obce Vrakúň, okrsok 2 časť obce Nekyje na Ostrove). The Internet Archive's captures of vrakun.sk (CDX 2017–2026) hold no okrsky document of 2017, 2018, 2019 or 2020 and none for 2024 (the 2024 elections pages and the one PDF retrievable hold only e-mail notices; other captures failed to load).

502014.name: Vydrany
502014.note: The mayor's decision of 15.03.2024 for the European Parliament election (Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností) sets 2 okrsky but gives only their polling stations (Kultúrny dom č. 534, Budova základných škôl č. 613), not their houses; no house list for this vote is on the website (the presidential election's list was posted 21.2.2024 and taken down 8.3.2024) or in the Internet Archive. The register has one part only, so the okrsky cannot be drawn from the polling stations.

502022.name: Zlaté Klasy
502022.note: The municipality has an elections page for each vote (live and in the Internet Archive), but none of them links an okrsky document (they hold the information for voters, delegation forms and the okrsky commissions' minutes). The only okrsky document found, "rozdelenie ulíc do okrskov" (evt_file.php?file=7010), is on the page of the 2022 municipal and regional elections, a vote not among these.

502031.name: Levice
502031.note: The live website's election pages list only results (minutes per okrsok) for this vote, no mayor's okrsky document; the úradná tabuľa (CG eGOV) shows only current postings. The Internet Archive's CDX for levice.sk answered 504/timeouts for most years over ~20 minutes of retries (only 2018 and 2020 lists came back, without okrsky documents); its captures of the old elections pages hold no okrsky notice. The council's obvody resolution of 02.08.2018 lists 47 okrsky but is no document of this vote.

502219.name: Drženice
502219.note: No okrsky document for this vote found: drzenice.sk has no elections section and its live notice board keeps only current notices; the Internet Archive holds few files of the site (opaque download_file_f.php ids). Every archived file captured in the weeks around this vote's okrsky deadline was opened (text or OCR); none is this vote's okrsky notice. Other votes' notices (referendum 2023, NR SR 2023, referendum 2026) cannot be used for this vote.

502421.name: Kozárovce
502421.note: The 2024 EP document (oznamenie-adresy-a-pocet-vytvorenych-volebnych-okrskov.pdf, 23.02.2024) exists but gives only the polling station. Kozárovce has one part and no streets (1005 addresses by súpisné číslo); its okrsky documents (2022, 2023 NRSR, 2024 EP) only state that there are 2 okrsky, both voting in ZŠ s MŠ Kozárovce č. 927, without any addresses or house numbers per okrsok, so no split of the village can be written or inferred.

502642.name: Plášťovce
502642.note: The live website has no elections section; its notice board and archive reach back only to spring 2026 and hold no okrsky document. The Internet Archive (web.archive.org CDX API) stayed offline (HTTP 503 / connection failures) for over 20 minutes of retries with pauses, so archived pages of earlier votes could not be searched.

502693.name: Pukanec
502693.note: The website has no elections section; the notice board lists only current items, the per-vote pages found (presidential 2024, referendum 2026) are gone (404) and the referendum 2023 page no longer links documents. The host also rate-limits (HTTP 429). Internet Archive (CDX API) refused connections / 503 on retries, so archived pages could not be checked.

502821.name: Tekovské Lužany
502821.note: Every okrsky notice on the website (president 2019 of 30.01.2019, referendum 2023, NR SR 2023 of 22.06.2023, president 2024, EP 2024, referendum 2026 of 24.04.2026) only gives the number of okrsky (3) and their polling stations (Obecný úrad SNP 43, Základná škola J. A. Komenského 37, bývalá MŠ Družstevná 87), not which streets vote where; the municipality has a single part, so no okrsok can be inferred from its station. No 2017 or 2018 okrsky document is on the site. The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout.

502987.name: Želiezovce
502987.note: For the European Parliament election 2024 the elections page lists voter information (SK/EN), the e-mail notice, candidates and the minutes, no okrsky document; none in the Internet Archive.

503321.name: Lipová
503321.note: The current website keeps election documents only for the October 2026 elections (and results of the 2026 referendum); no okrsky document of this vote and no older election pages. The Internet Archive was unreachable (connection refused) throughout.

503401.name: Mužla
503401.note: The archived "Voľby do EP" page (2024-04-16) links "Volebné okrsky" (wp-content/uploads/2024/02/volebne-okrsky.docx), but the Internet Archive has no capture of that file and it is gone (404) live. The website was rebuilt in 2025; its older files are gone (404) and the Internet Archive kept neither this vote's okrsky document nor the pages listing it.

503568.name: Svodín
503568.note: No okrsky document found for this vote. The live elections page has only the 2026 municipal documents (with the 2026 okrsky list); the 2026 referendum notice has only the commission records; the site search for 'okrsk' finds nothing older. The Internet Archive's captures of the old (WordPress) and new site's election pages and notices (2017, 2018, 2019, referendum 2023, NR SR 2023) list voters' information, postal vote, e-mail and council-size notices, but no okrsky document, and its CDX of svodin.sk has no okrsky file.

503584.name: Štúrovo
503584.note: The city publishes an "Informácia pre voličov o určení volebných okrskov a miestností" per vote; the live elections pages keep it for the NR SR election 2023, the presidential election 2024 and the referendum 2026 only. The pages of this vote (live or as archived in the Internet Archive) link no such document (the 2019 page only the decision calling the election and the voter information; the EP 2024 page only results).

503592.name: Šurany
503592.note: The elections pages list okrsky documents only for the referendums of 2023 and 2026 and the 2026 elections; no okrsky document of the European Parliament election of 2024 found. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline for us).

503614.name: Tvrdošovce
503614.note: No okrsky document with streets found. The municipality's election pages (old site, live at archiv.tvrdosovce.sk/informacie/volby, 2013-2024; new site tvrdosovce.sk/volby.html from 2026) give for 2017 and 2023 only the polling stations of the 4 okrsky (ZŠ Nová cesta; Obecný/Kultúrny dom for 2 and 3; MŠ Hlboká), with no streets, and for the other votes no okrsky notice at all; the Internet Archive's index adds nothing. With one part and 4 okrsky the split cannot be inferred.

503649.name: Zemné
503649.note: The notice of 04.02.2024 forms "2 volebné okrsky" with both polling stations in Dom Jedlika, Zemné č. 1, but does not say which houses vote in which okrsok; the okrsky cannot be inferred.

503711.name: Diakovce
503711.note: The website's elections section has pages only for NR SR 2020 (voter information, e-mail address, call — no okrsky), 2022 and 2026; no okrsky document for this vote. The Internet Archive was flaky/refusing connections during the search.

503746.name: Dolné Saliby
503746.note: The municipality's okrsky documents found (2022-11, 2023-06-26, 2024-01-19, 2026-07-30; scans) only create 'Volebný okrsok č. 1' and 'Volebný okrsok č. 2' with one shared polling room (Kultúrny dom 482, later Dolné Saliby 479); none says which addresses or voters belong to which okrsok (the register has no streets, all 887 addresses in one part; the split is evidently by voter list, e.g. alphabetical), so no rules can be written. No document of 2017-2020 found on the website (WordPress search for okrsky/volebná miestnosť); the Internet Archive CDX query did not answer.

503835.name: Jelka
503835.note: The 2024 EP page has the declaration, voter information and the commissions' minutes, no okrsky document. Jelka publishes for its votes only the number of okrsky and their polling stations (e.g. https://jelka.sk/wp-content/uploads/dokumenty/volby-do-narodnej-rady-sr/doc02890320230807110021-9h1175.pdf for 2023 and https://jelka.sk/wp-content/uploads/dokumenty/volby-prezidenta/doc03233820240130132240-197baj.pdf for 2024: okrsky 1 and 2 in the same building on Školská, okrsok 3 at Hlavná 760), never which streets vote where; with 3 okrsky in one part of the municipality they cannot be turned into rules.

503959.name: Pata
503959.note: No okrsky notice for this vote: the live election pages (2024 presidential and EP) and every archived elections page of obecpata.sk (2018–2024, captured before the votes) carry only the announcement and voter information, no 'oznámenie o vytvorení volebných okrskov'; the site publishes the okrsky (by súpisné číslo) only on the 2022 and 2026 pages. Another vote's notice is not this vote's.

504009.name: Sereď
504009.note: The only archived capture of the EP 2024 elections page (2024-03-29) links the speaker's decision, voter information and the commissions notice, not yet the okrsky; the new website keeps only the 2026 elections' documents.

504025.name: Šaľa
504025.note: No okrsky document for the EP election of 2024 found in the Internet Archive's captures of the town's articles. The town's website answers 'Access Forbidden' to our requests, so only Internet Archive copies could be used.

504068.name: Tešedíkovo
504068.note: Found 'Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností pre voľby do Európskeho parlamentu' of 15.2.2024 (obsah1202_4.pdf), but it names only the three polling stations. Every okrsky document Tešedíkovo published (referendum 2023, NR SR 2023, president 2024, EP 2024, referendum 2026, municipal/regional 2026) gives each of its 3 okrsky only its polling station (Dom kultúry č. 860; MŠ č. 153; Školská jedáleň ZŠ č. 974), never which houses vote where. The municipality has one part and no streets in the register, so the okrsky cannot be placed or inferred from the stations (the prompt's part-inference needs as many parts as okrsky).

504106.name: Trstice
504106.note: The mayor's 'Oznámenie o utvorení volebných okrskov v obci Trstice pre voľby do Európskeho parlamentu dňa 8.6.2024' (notice-board item 276, dated 5.3.2024, https://www.trstice.sk/e_download.php?file=/data/uredni_deska/obsah276_1.pdf) lists only the 3 okrsky with their polling stations (Okrsok č. 1 Obecný úrad č. 667, č. 2 Komunitný dom č. 1322, č. 3 Základná škola č. 647), no house numbers or territory. Trstice has a single part and no streets (all addresses are súpisné čísla), so a list of polling stations alone cannot be turned into rules (3 okrsky, 1 part). The voters per okrsok shifted markedly from March to June 2024, so the split likely changed (the 2026 announcement gives 1–500, 501–1000, 1001–), but no document of this vote states it. Every item of the official notice board (úradná tabuľa, items 1–444, 2016–2026, incl. the items migrated from the old Joomla site) was listed by id and every election item opened; the Internet Archive (CDX of trstice.sk, old site trstice.sk/sk/aktuality/…) was searched for election pages and radio announcements (hlásenie miestneho rozhlasu) around the vote; the IA was slow and often refused connections, but the pages listed in tried were retrieved.

504122.name: Veľká Mača
504122.note: Veľká Mača's okrsky documents (2023 NRSR, 2024 president, 2024 EP, 2026 municipal/regional) only create 2 okrsky and name their polling stations, both in the same building (Obecný úrad, Sereďská 137: zasadačka / sobášna sieň); none assigns streets or house numbers. The municipality has one part and no street names, so the okrsky cannot be inferred from stations. No 2017–2022 documents are on the site and the Internet Archive has no captures of velkamaca.sk for 2017–2022.

504131.name: Veľké Úľany
504131.note: The municipality's okrsky notices (2024 presidential, 2026) give only the four polling stations, all in the same part (Veľké Úľany, Hlavná 579/8 and 578/9), with no streets or parts per okrsok; no document with streets is on the website, and the Internet Archive keeps only the old frames site (no election documents for 2017–2023).

504203.name: Senica
504203.note: The city's election articles are reused for each new vote (the municipal and regional pages now show 2026 only), so this vote's documents are no longer linked; older files survive only under unknown article/file ids. The Internet Archive's CDX was offline ('Temporarily Offline', HTTP 503) for over 15 minutes, so archived copies could not be searched.

504254.name: Brestovec
504254.note: This vote's document was found, but The okrsky documents of 2023 (referendum, NR SR), 2024 (president, EP) and the 2026 referendum give only the two polling stations (zasadačka OcÚ/KD Brestovec 189/273; kancelária PD Poriadie 412) and no osady, house numbers or streets; Brestovec is one part without streets, so the okrsky cannot be drawn from them.

504351.name: Gbely
504351.note: The page 'Volebné okrsky a miestnosti do Európskeho parlamentu' has the document for the EP election 2024: 4 okrsky, each 'ZŠsMŠ Gbely', Pionierska 697, with no streets. Gbely (4 okrsky in 3 parts: Gbely, Adamov, Cunín) publishes for each vote only 'Volebné okrsky a miestnosti': every okrsok with its polling station, all of them in the same building (ZŠ s MŠ Gbely, Pionierska 697), with no streets or parts. Such a document cannot be turned into rules (the stations do not lie in different parts, and the okrsky outnumber the parts), so per the prompt this is not_found; no street list of the okrsky was found on the website or by web search.

504416.name: Jablonica
504416.note: The EP 2024 okrsky notice exists on the notice board (page 992). The okrsky documents of this municipality (2015/16, 2022, 2024) define the two okrsky by street names (okrsok 1: Červenej armády, Dúbrava, Hurbanova, …; okrsok 2: Bernolákova, Bosý Jarok, Brezie, …), but the address register has no streets for Jablonica (all 946 addresses are without a street, one part, one k.ú.), so no rule can select those streets and the document cannot be turned into valid rules without guessing.

504769.name: Rohožník
504769.note: No document of this vote assigning addresses to okrsky found live or in the Internet Archive. The only Rohožník document with an address split is the 2024 presidential one (súpisné čísla 1–381 / 382–395 / 396–800, dated 24.1.2024); other okrsky documents on the site (e.g. the NR SR 2020 / 2026 'Určenie volebných okrskov') list only the polling station (all three in the same school), so they cannot place addresses.

504815.name: Skalica
504815.note: The European Parliament 2024 page is empty live and as archived (1.10.2024); no okrsky document for this vote found live or in the Internet Archive.

504891.name: Šaštín-Stráže
504891.note: Šaštín-Stráže publishes for each vote only the addresses of the polling stations (e.g. "Adresy volebných okrskov pre Referendum v r. 2026": okrsok 1 ZŠ Hviezdoslavova 1462 in Stráže, okrsky 2 and 3 both in the Mestský úrad, Alej 549, Šaštín); no document says which streets of Šaštín belong to okrsok 2 or 3, so no rules can be written. Older votes' pages are gone from the new website, and the Internet Archive stayed unreachable (CDX timeouts / connection refused) during the search.

504980.name: Závod
504980.note: The 2024 European Parliament page lists only 'Oznámenie o čase a mieste konania volieb' (a single form naming one room, no territory of the okrsky); no okrsky document of 8.6.2024 is published.

504998.name: Topoľčany
504998.note: The archived notice 'Voľby do Európskeho parlamentu' (IA capture of 6 Apr 2024) links 'Volebne_okrsky_a_volebne_miestnosti_urcenie.pdf' (download_file_f.php?id=2009026), but the file is gone from topolcany.sk (HTTP 404), the live notice is emptied and the Internet Archive has no copy of the file. The Internet Archive's CDX timed out or answered 'Temporarily Offline' for most queries (2017, 2019 never answered; 2018, 2020 returned nothing).

505374.name: Prašice
505374.note: The page 'Voľby do Európskeho parlamentu 2024' is archived only on 13 Feb 2024 (announcement and voter information); its later attachments (an okrsky document, if posted) were never captured, and the page is gone from the current website. No okrsky document of the 2024 EP election found. The Internet Archive was intermittently offline during the search; it was retried until it answered.

505498.name: Solčany
505498.note: The page of the European Parliament 2024 lists no okrsky document (call, information, commission documents and minutes only). The municipality's okrsky documents (e.g. 2024 presidential) name only the polling stations, no streets.

505714.name: Veľké Ripňany
505714.note: Found in the Internet Archive: https://web.archive.org/web/20240229135731/https://www.velkeripnany.sk/data/news_files/velkeripnany.sk/79621/urcenie-okrskov.png (same three okrsky as NR SR 2023: okrsok 1 Topoľčianska, Piešťanská, Obsolovská, Nitrianska, Školská, Malinová, Muškátová, Nábrežná, Mlynská; okrsok 2 Hlohovecká, Kút, Majerská, Mládežnícka, Nová, Poštová, Vieska, Vinohradská, Studená dolina, Orechová; okrsok 3 Hlavná, Okružná, Staničná, Družstevná, Pri zvonici), but the Archive kept refusing connections when the ingest fetched them for over 15 minutes; reported not_found so it can be retried.

505722.name: Veľké Uherce
505722.note: The 2024 European Parliament elections page lists only the decision calling the vote, voter information, e-mail addresses and results; no okrsky document, live or in the Internet Archive.

505901.name: Čachtice
505901.note: The 2024 EP document (Zoznam volebných okrskov, posted 27. 2. 2024) lists okrsky 1-3 only with their common polling station, no streets; Čachtice has one part, so the okrsky cannot be drawn from it. The street lists of 2018 and 2023 (and 2026) give the same three okrsky.

505943.name: Dolná Súča
505943.note: No okrsky document of this vote found on the website (notice board and site search); the only one found, for the 2026 referendum, does not define the okrsky's territory. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline for us).

505960.name: Drietoma
505960.note: Drietoma (one part, no streets) publishes for its votes only the number of okrsky and their common polling station (prístavba kultúrneho domu súp. č. 321), e.g. "Volebné okrsky a zapisovateľky" (referendum 2023); no document says which houses vote in which okrsok, so no rules can be written.

506010.name: Horná Súča
506010.note: The municipality's okrsky documents (referendum 2023 of 09.11.2022, NR SR 2023, prezident 2024, referendum 2026 of 06.05.2026) give each of the 6 okrsky only its polling station (1 knižnica č. 233 and 2 MŠ č. 235 both in Horná Súča, 3 Dúbrava, 4 Závrská, 5 Vlčí Vrch, 6 Trnávka); the municipality has 7 parts (Dolná/Horná Závrská, Krásny Dub, ...) and two okrsky lie in part Horná Súča, so the okrsky cannot be given by the parts of their stations, and no document says which addresses vote where.

506036.name: Horné Srnie
506036.note: The EP 2024 page lists no okrsky document.

506141.name: Kostolné
506141.note: The archived section lists the post "Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností pre voľby do EP 2024" (6. 3. 2024), but the post itself was never archived and is gone from the live site (404); kostolne.sk's EP 2024 page has only minutes and voter information. The 2023 documents split okrsok 1 = Kostolné and okrsok 2 = Babulicov Vrch with the hamlets.

506150.name: Krajné
506150.note: The decisions for the 2023 referendum (10.11.2022), NR SR 2023 (23.06.2023), presidential 2024 (26.01.2024) and EP 2024 (01.03.2024) give each okrsok only its polling station (okrsok 1: Obecný úrad Krajné, okrsok 2: Kultúrny dom Matejovec), without houses or parts; the municipality has 6 parts for 2 okrsky, so the okrsky cannot be drawn from the stations. No okrsky document for 2017–2020 or the 2026 referendum is on the website.

506281.name: Nemšová
506281.note: The EP 2024 page names only the 6 okrsky's polling stations (okrsky 1–3 all in the Kultúrne centrum, SNP 1), no streets; the split of part Nemšová between okrsky 1–3 is not given.

506427.name: Podolie
506427.note: No okrsky document of this vote on the website (notice board archive and site search). The only okrsky document with two okrsky (NR SR 30.9.2023) says "Okrsok č.1 Obec Podolie; Okrsok č. 2 Podolie – časť Kopanice" without house numbers; Kopanice is not a part, street or k.ú. in the register (one part Podolie, no streets, addresses only by súpisné číslo), so okrsok 2 cannot be drawn without guessing its houses. The Internet Archive was offline (connection refused, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

506508.name: Soblahov
506508.note: Soblahov has no streets and one part (804 addresses by súpisné číslo). Its elections pages (2017-2026) hold no okrsky document with addresses; the one it publishes ("Utvorenie volebných okrskov s vymedzením ich územného obvodu", 2022) says only that 2 okrsky are formed, both voting in the Obecný úrad Soblahov 470, without saying which houses belong to which; so no rules can be written.

506559.name: Trenčianska Teplá
506559.note: The website's election pages (2022–2026) hold only OVK minutes and results, no okrsky announcement for this vote; the referendum 2026 page links a file on trencin.sk (another municipality's website), not usable. The Internet Archive was offline (connection refused, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

506842.name: Brestovany
506842.note: Oznámenie of 12.02.2024 for the EP election. The document creates 2 okrsky but gives each only its polling station (okrsok 1: Kultúrny dom, okrsok 2: malá sála obecného úradu, both at J. Nižnanského 474/6 in Brestovany), no streets or parts. The municipality has 2 parts (Brestovany, Horné Lovčice) but both stations lie in the same building in Brestovany, so the okrsky cannot be inferred from the stations' parts.

506851.name: Bučany
506851.note: The municipality's okrsky notices (live: referendum 2026, 12.5.2026; archived: presidential 2024, 19.1.2024; referendum 2023, 14.11.2022) name only the polling rooms of okrsok 1 and 2 (Kultúrny dom and Dom služieb, both on Námestie sv. Floriána), with no streets; Bučany has a single part, so the okrsky cannot be drawn. The archived pages of 2018, 2019, 2020 and EP 2024 have no okrsky document; the NR SR 2023 page could not be fetched from the Archive.

507121.name: Chtelnica
507121.note: The municipality's okrsky notices (referendum 2023, presidential and EP 2024, referendum 2026) only state "utváram volebný okrsok č. 1 a volebný okrsok č. 2" with one polling station (Základná škola, Námestie 1. mája 3) for both; they never say which streets vote where, and Chtelnica has one part, so no rules can be written.

507199.name: Kočín-Lančár
507199.note: No document on the okrsky of this vote: the page has only the voter information. (The okrsky are presumably Kočín and Lančár as in the council obvody, but no document of this vote says so.)

507288.name: Madunice
507288.note: No okrsky document found for this vote. The live elections page (Voľby a referendum) keeps only the 2026 notices (Referendum 04.07.2026, Spojené voľby 2026). Its capture of 2022-03-19 lists for 2017–2020 only candidate lists, voters' information, the decisions calling elections, the commission delegation and the results; no 'utvorenie volebných okrskov' or street list. The Internet Archive's CDX of madunice.sk (2017–2026) has no other election notice, and no capture of the page between 2022 and 2025 lists the 2022–2024 votes. The host (webygroup) was fetched sparingly because of its rate limit.

507342.name: Moravany nad Váhom
507342.note: Moravany nad Váhom's live notice board lists only current items; probing its board files (e_download.php obsah150-620) found an okrsky decision only for the NR SR election 2023 (and 2022, 2026 municipal); none for this vote. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline) during the search.

507555.name: Smolenice
507555.note: No okrsky document for this vote: the website's elections pages (and their Internet Archive captures, old and new site) list for it only voters' information, voting-card forms, e-mail notices and results.

507601.name: Špačince
507601.note: The municipality's elections pages hold only results and candidate lists (2018–2020) or link to the ministry's website (2023–2024); no okrsky document of any vote was found on the website, its notice archive, or in the Internet Archive (CDX returned nothing).

507636.name: Šúrovce
507636.note: The website's elections page and notice board (current and archive) hold only 2026 documents; no okrsky document of this vote found. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline for us).

507709.name: Veľké Kostoľany
507709.note: Every okrsky document of Veľké Kostoľany found (prezident 2024 of 29.01.2024, EP 2024 of 29.02.2024, referendum 2026, municipal 2026 of 14.07.2026) only names 2 okrsky with one polling station (sála kultúrneho domu) and does not say which streets or houses vote in which okrsok; no document of 2017-2023 found live. The Internet Archive (CDX) stayed offline on repeated attempts over ~20 minutes, so archived pages for this vote could not be checked.

507750.name: Vrbové
507750.note: The page of the EP elections 2024 links no okrsky list (only voter information, e-mail addresses and the notice of time and place); no okrsky document of this vote was found. Another vote's list is not this vote's.

507849.name: Budmerice
507849.note: The Webygroup website keeps no elections page; its notice board and announcements now list only items of late 2026, and the site search finds no okrsky document of this vote (only the 2026 municipal elections' minutes). The Internet Archive (CDX API and web.archive.org) was unreachable for over 20 minutes, so archived copies could not be checked.

507857.name: Častá
507857.note: No okrsky decision for the EP election of 8.6.2024 among the posts or the scanned PDFs of Feb-May 2024 (the 10.1.2024 decision names only the presidential election). The Internet Archive (web.archive.org, incl. the CDX API) refused connections throughout (about 45 minutes, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

507890.name: Gajary
507890.note: Gajary publishes for each vote only "informácia o počte volebných okrskov a určení volebných miestností": 2 okrsky, both in the Obecný úrad, Hlavná 67/105 (right and left room), and per-voter notices ("Oznámenie o čase a mieste konania volieb", a template for one address); no document on the website or in the Internet Archive says which streets or houses vote in okrsok 1 or 2, so no rules can be written.

508055.name: Lozorno
508055.note: No okrsky document for the European Parliament election 2024 (the live Voľby page has no okrsky document for it, only the minutes; none captured in the Internet Archive). The Internet Archive was reachable (after a short outage). Other votes' documents split the obec by súpisné číslo (2018: 1-600 / 601-; 2022-2026: 1-700 / 701-).

508110.name: Most pri Bratislave
508110.note: The municipality's elections section lists an okrsky announcement only for the NR SR election 2023; none of the EP election 2024 (the 2017 entry has only candidate lists). Internet Archive offline.

508136.name: Nová Dedinka
508136.note: The archived 2017 elections page (Voľby VÚC 2017) links no okrsky document. Every okrsky notice Nová Dedinka published (2022 municipal/regional: download_file_f.php?id=1718007, 1720353; 2024 presidential: id=1879554) only says the village has 2 okrsky, both in the Základná škola, Hlavná 45 (okrsok 1 'trieda vpravo', okrsok 2 'trieda vľavo'), with no streets or parts. Both polling stations lie in the same building in part Dedinka pri Dunaji, so not even a part-per-station assignment can be inferred; no document assigns addresses to okrsky.

508195.name: Plavecký Štvrtok
508195.note: The archived EP 2024 page (2024-03-26) links "Určenie volebných okrskov a volebných miestností.pdf" (download_file_f.php?id=2005502), but the file is gone from the website (404) and the Internet Archive never captured it.

508217.name: Senec
508217.note: The city's current website keeps only the 2022 and 2026 elections; the Internet Archive kept the old website's okrsky decisions for the presidential and EP elections of 2019, the NR SR election 2020 and the presidential election 2024, but none for this vote.

508225.name: Slovenský Grob
508225.note: For 2017 and 2018 the archived election pages link 'volebne_okrsky.pdf', but the Internet Archive never captured the file and the old site is gone; the archived pages for NR SR 2020 and both 2024 votes link no okrsky document, and the new website has none for them.

508292.name: Veľký Biel
508292.note: All files of the notice board (data/uredni_deska/obsah1..514; scans OCR-read) and its election folders were checked: okrsky documents exist only for the elections of 2022 (obsah191_7) and of 24.10.2026 (obsah511/515); for this vote there is none (only voter information, delegation addresses and commission minutes).

508306.name: Viničné
508306.note: The old website (archiv.vinicne.sk) ends in June 2019; the new website (Webygroup) shows only the 2026 municipal elections' documents on its elections page, and the Internet Archive has no capture of an okrsky notice for this vote (only the commissions' minutes for 2024). No document of this vote found.

508381.name: Zohor
508381.note: The elections page of this vote (https://www.obeczohor.sk/24692/volby-do-europskeho-parlamentu-2024) has no okrsky document (empty or only minutes/results). The Internet Archive was not reachable reliably.

508675.name: Brusno
508675.note: The European Parliament 2024 page on brusno.sk lists only the decision calling the election and voter information; no okrsky decision.

508870.name: Pohorelá
508870.note: The obec's page "Voľby do Európskeho parlamentu 2024" lists voter information, e-mail addresses and minutes, but no okrsky notice; the site search finds none either. The Internet Archive (CDX API) stayed unreachable for about 15 minutes of retries, so archived copies could not be checked.

508888.name: Pohronská Polhora
508888.note: The vote's page has the mayor's decision forming 'dva okrsky' with polling rooms only (both in the obecný úrad, Hlavná 62); no streets per okrsok and the obec has one part, so the okrsky cannot be drawn from it. Internet Archive (CDX API) refused connections / 503 on retries, so archived pages could not be checked.

508900.name: Polomka
508900.note: Every Polomka okrsky document found (2022 municipal/regional letter of 1.8.2022, NRSR 2023 decision of 26.6.2023, EP 2024 decision of 22.2.2024, referendum 2026 notice) only creates 3 okrsky and gives each the same polling station (Základná škola, Komenského 34); none names streets or parts per okrsok. 3 okrsky vs 2 parts with one shared station, so no part inference is possible. The EP 2024 decision lists stations only.

509124.name: Závadka nad Hronom
509124.note: The archived EP 2024 page lists only the decision, voter info and e-mail notices; no okrsky document. Internet Archive was intermittently unreachable.

509159.name: Čierne
509159.note: The EP 2024 document (15.02.2024) only names the polling stations. Every okrsky document of Čierne found (referendum 2023 of 10.11.2022, NR SR 2023 of 12.06.2023, president 2024 of 22.01.2024, EP 2024 of 15.02.2024, referendum 2026 of 21.04.2026, OSO/VÚC 2026 of 07.07.2026) only names the three polling stations (1: Kultúrny dom Čierne Ústredie 189; 2: škola Čierne Ústredie 183; 3: ZŠ s MŠ Čierne VK 969) and assigns no houses, hamlets or numbers to the okrsky. Čierne has no streets and one part (Čierne) for 3 okrsky, so the okrsky cannot be turned into rules (okrsky not as many as parts).

509213.name: Klokočov
509213.note: The municipality's okrsky notices (NR SR 2023, presidential 2024, EP 2024) name the three okrsky only as "Klokočov", "Klokočov - Klin" and "Klokočov - Hlavice" with their polling rooms; the municipality has 9 parts (Hlavice, Hrubý Buk, Javorová, Klin, Klokočov, Kornica, Riečky, Rybárie, Vrchpredmier) and the notices do not say which parts belong to which okrsok, so the okrsky cannot be drawn.

509230.name: Korňa
509230.note: The website's news on the 2020 NR SR and 2024 presidential elections link only voter information, records of results and the e-mail addresses; the site search finds an okrsky announcement only for the 2022 elections. No okrsky document of this vote found. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline for us).

509248.name: Krásno nad Kysucou
509248.note: The town's "utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností" (2017, 2018, EP 2019, NR SR 2020, referendum 2023, presidential and EP 2024, referendum 2026) list only the 6 polling stations, never which parts or houses vote where; the 6 okrsky do not match the 4 parts (the part Krásno nad Kysucou is split), so no rules can be written.

509264.name: Kysucký Lieskovec
509264.note: The website (behind a proof-of-work browser check, passed) keeps election pages only for 2026; the referendum 2026 page lists no okrsky document (only the call, voter information, delegation of commission members, voting pass, results). Nothing for this vote is online. The Internet Archive was offline (connection refused, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

509302.name: Nesluša
509302.note: The election page for the European Parliament election of 8 June 2024 states the okrsky the mayor set only by their polling stations (no. 1 Obecný úrad, Nesluša 978; no. 2 Základná škola, Nesluša 837), not which addresses vote in each okrsok. The obec has a single part (Nesluša) and no streets (all 1282 addresses numbered by súpisné číslo), so two okrsky cannot be drawn from polling stations or parts. The Internet Archive's CDX for neslusa.sk answered for 2017 and 2018 (no okrsky document among the captures) but stayed 'Temporarily Offline' / 504 for 2019–2026 after several retries with pauses.

509337.name: Olešná
509337.note: Olešná (obecolesna.sk) publishes per vote an 'Oznámenie o utvorení volebných okrskov' (referendum 2023, NR SR 2023, prezident 2024) that names only the two polling stations, with no extent; the EP 2024 'Informácia' names hamlets per okrsok (1: Sklený vrch, Šulkov Potok, Predná Olešná, Priečnica, Rovňany; 2: Potôčky, Polgrúň, Burkov vrch), which the register does not have as parts or streets (one part Olešná, all addresses by súpisné číslo), so no rules can be written from it. No document for the other votes. Internet Archive offline.

509345.name: Oščadnica
509345.note: The EP 2024 files Obvod-01..06 are the okrsky commissions' result protocols; no okrsky document giving houses per okrsok found. The municipality's okrsky announcements list okrsky only by polling station, which with one part and no streets cannot be turned into rules.

509451.name: Skalité
509451.note: Skalité has one part and no streets in the address register (all 1,624 addresses by súpisné číslo); the municipality describes its 4 okrsky (and the 2 obvody, each = two okrsky) only by hamlet names and polling stations, never by house numbers, so no rule of the allowed kinds (street, part, k.ú.) can separate them. The website's elections section keeps only the 2023, 2026 pages; no document of this vote with house numbers was found.

509477.name: Stará Bystrica
509477.note: Stará Bystrica announces for each vote only that it forms 2 okrsky, both voting in the Základná škola Stará Bystrica 548 (classes 1.A/1.B or 3.A/3.B); no document says which houses belong to okrsok 1 or 2 (the register has no streets; its parts Stará Bystrica and Lány do not match the okrsky' voters), so no rules can be written.

509485.name: Staškov
509485.note: No okrsky document of this vote on the website (it keeps election material only from 2026). The okrsky decision Staškov publishes (referendum 2026, 05.05.2026) only creates 2 okrsky with rooms in the same building (vestibul / spoločenská sála OÚ) and gives no territory; the register has one part and no streets, so the okrsky cannot be drawn. The Internet Archive was offline (connection refused, retried with pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

509493.name: Svrčinovec
509493.note: No okrsky document of the EP election of 8 June 2024 on svrcinovec.sk: the site search (okrsk, okrskov, volby, voľby, referendum, urcenie) finds only the elections pages of 2017, 2018 and the 2019 presidential election. The calendar page of this vote gives only the three polling stations (okrsok 001 moved to the ZŠ in 2024), no territory. The Internet Archive (CDX of svrcinovec.sk 2017–2026, after several retries while it was temporarily offline) holds no okrsky document of this vote: its captures of the notice board attachments do not cover the election announcements, and no elections page of this vote is archived. The decisions of 2017 and 2019 that exist define the okrsky only by kopanice names absent from the register, so they could not be transcribed either. Svrčinovec has no streets and one part (Svrčinovec); every address is a súpisné číslo. The okrsky documents of 2017 and of the presidential election of 2019 (identical lists) define the 3 okrsky only by kopanice/osady names: okrsok 1 U Jurištov, U Skorky, U Mišov, U Katraka, U Krišice, U Hlaváča, U Berka, U Švoľka, U Cyprichov, Pod Grapami, U Puraša, U Privarčáka; okrsok 2 U Kupky, Pod bučky a valy, U Vajdíka, U Meščky, U Kubale, U Okapola, U Janka, U Matiaška, U Blažkov; okrsok 3 U Liščáka, Škradné, Potok a Bordža (polling stations: kultúrny dom, ZŠ, kaplnka na Závrší). None of these names is a street, part or k.ú. of the register, and no source gives their house numbers. Seven of them (U Skorky, U Krišice, U Švoľka, U Meščky, U Kubale, U Okapola, U Janka) are not in ZBGIS geographic names (inspirews.skgeodesy.sk GN) or OSM at all, and the located ones of okrsky 1 and 2 are interleaved all over the village (e.g. Pod Grapami (1) west of Matiaškovci (2), Vajdíkovci (2) beside Jurištovci (1)). Assigning each register address to the nearest located osada gives 691/199/162 addresses for okrsky 1/2/3, against 1199/1294/311 voters on the roll in 2018 (okrsok 2 should be the largest), so the split between okrsky 1 and 2 (in particular of the village centre) cannot be drawn without guessing. Only okrsok 3 (Závršie, Škradné, Potok, separated from the centre) would be clear.

509515.name: Vysoká nad Kysucou
509515.note: The only okrsky document found for these votes (referendum 2023, archived) names each okrsok only by its area and polling station (1 Ústredie, 2 Nižný Kelčov, 3 Vyšný Kelčov), without the parts or houses it covers; the municipality has 8 parts and the part Vysoká nad Kysucou is split between okrsky 1 and 2, so the okrsky cannot be drawn from it. The website and the Internet Archive hold no other okrsky document for 2017–2026 (the 2026 area descriptions are for the October 2026 elections).

509523.name: Zákopčie
509523.note: No okrsky document of this vote on the village's website (the notice board, all pages, and the vote's items list none). The Internet Archive stayed offline ('Temporarily Offline') across several retries over more than 15 minutes, so archived pages could not be checked. The only okrsky decisions on the village's website are those for the referendum of 21 January 2023 (9 Nov 2022) and the National Council election of 2023 (12 Jun 2023); both only create 'dva volebné okrsky' with their rooms (zasadačka and kancelária č. 1, both in the municipal office) and name no parts, houses or numbers, so no territorial split can be written; the village has 6 parts and no streets, so the parts cannot be inferred from the stations either.

509531.name: Zborov nad Bystricou
509531.note: The vote's document (mayor's decision of 2024-02-14) says only: 'Volebný okrsok č. 1 – Dolný koniec; Volebný okrsok č. 2 – Horný koniec', both in ZŠ č. 604 – telocvičňa. Every okrsky document of the municipality (2019 to 2026, live on its website) names okrsok 1 only 'Dolný koniec' and okrsok 2 only 'Horný koniec', with no house numbers or settlements; the register has a single part (Zborov nad Bystricou), no streets and only súpisné čísla, and both okrsky vote in the same building, so neither parts nor polling stations can place any address: the document cannot be turned into rules. The Internet Archive (web.archive.org) refused connections on every try (several retries with 30-60 s pauses), so archived pages could not be checked.

509728.name: Klin
509728.note: The notice for the EP election 2024 (4.3.2024) names only 2 okrsky, both in the Kultúrny dom, without their streets.

509809.name: Lokca
509809.note: Lokca's notice board lists only current items; probing its board files (e_download.php obsah300-1310_1, text and OCR of scans) found an okrsky document only for the elections of October 2026 (obsah1230); none for this vote. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline) during the search.

509850.name: Mútne

509868.name: Námestovo

543519.name: Rudňany
543519.note: No document assigning houses to the two okrsky found. The municipality's okrsky decisions (rudnany.sk, Voľby: referendum 2023, NRSR 2023, presidential and EP 2024) only name the two polling stations (ZŠ s. č. 96; obecný úrad s. č. 234); the pages of 2018-2020 and of the referendum 2026 carry no okrsky notice. The municipality has no streets (houses by súpisné číslo in one part), so the split cannot be inferred.

543535.name: Slovinky
543535.note: The only okrsky decision found (EP 2024, 05.03.2024) names the two okrsky's polling rooms (Kultúrny dom Slovinky 58, Komunitné centrum Slovinky 379) without saying which houses vote where; the municipality is one part with no streets, so the okrsky cannot be drawn. Other votes' pages carry no okrsky document; the Internet Archive has no captures of obecslovinky.sk.

543578.name: Spišské Podhradie
543578.note: The EP 2024 page (archived 2024-03-01) links 'Vytvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebných miestností' (file_storage 25590392|1657), but the file is gone live and was not archived.

543772.name: Somotor
543772.note: No okrsky decision of this vote on the municipality's website: its document category for this vote (obecsomotor.sk/dokumenty, Voľby 2018 / Voľby do Európskeho parlamentu 2024) has notices, candidate lists and results but no okrsky decision.

543802.name: Streda nad Bodrogom
543802.note: The municipality's okrsky decisions (EP 2019, 22.02.2019; 2022; referendum 2023, 09.11.2022) only name the two okrsky's seats (Hlavná 390/176 or 391/174, and the cultural house Hlavná 217/127) without saying which streets or houses vote where; the okrsky cannot be drawn from them. Other votes' pages carry no okrsky document.

543951.name: Vojčice
543951.note: The live website (obecvojcice.sk) keeps only the 2026 election pages and a short notice board; neither has an okrsky announcement (the 2026 'Oznámenie o čase a mieste konania volieb' names only the polling station Kultúrny dom - svadobka and the okrsok number, no streets). Older pages are gone, and the Internet Archive stayed offline for this domain (CDX queries answered 'Temporarily Offline' / 504 on repeated attempts over about an hour), so no earlier document could be looked up. Web search found nothing.

544051.name: Vranov nad Topľou
544051.note: The vote pages under Úradná tabuľa » Voľby a referendá now hold only results; the announcements published before the vote (on the home-page election sections and news) were removed, and the Internet Archive keeps no okrsky document of this vote (its CDX of vranov.sk download.php files has only the NR SR 2023 okrsky announcement).

544094.name: Bystré
544094.note: Found the vote's notice https://www.obecbystre.sk/files/2024-03-05-113431-image050324102442.pdf ('Informácia o utvorení volebných okrskov a určení volebných miestností', linked from https://www.obecbystre.sk/volby-do-europskeho-parlamentu-na-uzemi-slovenskej-republiky-informacie-pre-volica-a22-804). The document gives only the number of okrsky (2) and each okrsok's polling station (no. 1: Obecný úrad, Šarišská 98/20; no. 2: Komunitné centrum Bystré, Hamzova 630/2A), with no streets or houses. Bystré has a single part (Bystré) and both stations lie in it, so the okrsky cannot be placed by part; per the rules this is not_found. Every other okrsky notice of Bystré seen (NRSR 2023, president 2024, EP 2024, referendum 2026, municipal/regional 2026) is likewise stations only.

544116.name: Čaklov
544116.note: The elections page keeps only commission minutes (NRSR 2023, presidential and EP 2024, referendum 2026); the notice board's only okrsky notice ('Oznámenie o vytvorení volebných okrskov a určení volebných miestností', detail=74892) is of the 2026 municipal elections. No okrsky document of this vote; the Internet Archive was offline ('Temporarily Offline') during the search.

545651.name: Veľké Držkovce
545651.note: The website (new CMS since 2023) keeps no okrsky document of this vote and the Internet Archive has no capture of one (its captures of the domain begin in 2020 and hold only 2023 referendum, 2024 presidential and 2026 municipal okrsky notices). The 2024 and 2026 notices make each part of the municipality one okrsok (1 Čuklasovce, 2 Horné Držkovce, 3 Dolné Držkovce), but no document of this vote was found.

555576.name: Trhová Hradská
555576.note: The municipality's website (live and as archived since 2017) publishes for the votes only commission minutes, delegation addresses and voter information; no document creating the okrsky (utvorenie volebných okrskov / zoznam ulíc) for any vote 2017–2026 was found; a web search found none either.

555754.name: Matúškovo
555754.note: Matúškovo's okrsky documents (2023 NR SR 'Zverejnenie volebných okrskov a volebných miestností' of 27.06.2023, and the same for 2024 and 2026) give each okrsok only its polling station, both in the same building (Centrum voľného času, Matúškovo č. 513: okrsok 1 predsieň, okrsok 2 zasadačka); the municipality has one part and no streets in the register, so no rules can be derived from them (prompt: stations only and not one per part -> not_found). No document assigning streets or house numbers to the okrsky was found on the website, live or in the Internet Archive's CDX of matuskovo.sk 2017-2026.

556157.name: Jacovce
556157.note: The archived 2024 EP page links '4. Utvorenie volebných okrskov a určenie volebnej miestnosti pre Voľby do Európskeho parlamentu' (docs/aktuality/2024/007-4.pdf), but that PDF was never captured and is gone live.

556696.name: Nitrianske Hrnčiarovce
556696.note: The municipality's okrsky decisions for the votes of 2023-2024 (download_file_f.php?id=1763855, 1880559, 1988794, 2008220 on nitrianskehrnciarovce.sk) only state that 2 okrsky are formed with both polling stations in one building; they do not say which streets vote in which okrsok, so no rules can be written (the municipality has one part only). The Referendum 2026 page carries no okrsky document.

558320.name: Ivanka pri Nitre
558320.note: The 2024 EP notice lists only the three polling stations, no streets; one part, so no rules. The only okrsky documents on ivankaprinitre.sk are of 2022-11 (referendum 2023), 2023-06 (NR SR 2023), 2024-01 (president 2024), 2024-03 (EP 2024), giving only the three polling stations (all in the Kultúrny dom), and 2026-07 (municipal/regional 2026-10-24, with streets). Internet Archive was reachable.

559784.name: Turňa nad Bodvou
559784.note: No okrsky decision for this vote on the website's notice board (which keeps the 2022, 2022-11 referendum, 2024 presidential and 2026 decisions) or in the Internet Archive: the archived 2018–2020 election pages list only voter information and candidate lists (their 2018 'oznam' PDFs are 404 and not archived), and no decision for 2017, 2019, 2023-09, 2024-06 or the 2026 referendum is published.

560103.name: Vysoké Tatry
560103.note: The town's notice board keeps only current items (the October 2026 elections and the July 2026 referendum's minutes, no okrsky announcement); earlier announcements were removed and survive only in the Internet Archive, which was offline (the 2022 documents in this repository come from it). The host rate-limits requests (HTTP 429), so fetching was kept minimal.

560154.name: Smižany
560154.note: No okrsky document of the EP election 2024 (page has only minutes) on the website; Internet Archive offline; the host rate-limits requests.

580473.name: Biely Kostol
580473.note: The notice for the European Parliament election 2024 states only 2 okrsky and one polling station (ZŠ Bronzová 1); no list of streets per okrsok found live or archived.

580554.name: Čenkovce
580554.note: The website's elections page lists only the 2026 referendum article, whose files (results, information for voters, decision on the referendum) include no okrsky document; older votes are not on the current site. The site then refused our connections (blocked) and the Internet Archive refused connections too, so the notice board and older captures could not be checked; the maintainer may retry.

581020.name: Hrnčiarovce nad Parnou
581020.note: The mayor's decision of 26.02.2024 (Utvorenie volebného okrsku a určenie volebnej miestnosti pre voľby do Európskeho parlamentu v roku 2024) creates 2 okrsky but only names their polling station, the same Kultúrny dom, Farská 37, for both; it assigns no streets, and the municipality has one part, so the okrsky cannot be drawn from it.

581399.name: Banka
581399.note: The notice board (current and archive) and the site search find okrsky documents only for the 2022 elections and the 2023 referendum; no okrsky document of the European Parliament election of 2024 found. The Internet Archive refused connections (offline for us).

598224.name: Košice-Západ
598224.note: No okrsky document of this vote found: the district's current website (kosicezapad.sk, sections per vote under 'Voľby, referendá a SODB') holds only the commissions' minutes for the votes of 2023-2026, and the Internet Archive's index of kosicezapad.sk (including archiv.kosicezapad.sk) lists okrsky notices only for 2017, 2018, 2019, 2022 and the referendum of 2023.

599824.name: Košice-Juh
599824.note: The district's elections page linked an okrsky document for several votes (e.g. download/33319 for the referendum 2023, download/35781 for the NR SR election 2023, download/37199 for 2024), but the website has deleted them ("Download does not exist") and the Internet Archive kept none of them; for 2017–2020 the archived elections pages link no okrsky document. Only the 2026 documents remain online.

599875.name: Košice-Sídlisko Ťahanovce
599875.note: The EP 2024 page lists voter information, delegation and the decision; no okrsky document.
